bio: Located slightly elevated from the village and right next to the Schlegelkopf ski slope, this is the restaurant of the luxurious Aurelio Hotel & Chalet Lech. The interior is chic and the gorgeous terrace affords fabulous views of the 2 557m-high Omeshorn. The polished and attentive service really enhances the refined yet relaxed atmosphere. Diners can choose from a range of delicious options à la carte, from Atlantic turbot with radish, artichoke and creamy polenta to Wiener schnitzel or a Vorarlberg organic Wagyu beef burger. In the evening, another alternative is to pre-order Aurelio’s Gourmetmenü, a five- to eight- course set menu....
